name: R-Ladies Gaborone
description:
R-Ladies Gaborone is a chapter of [R-Ladies Global](https://rladies.org/), an organisation that promotes gender diversity in the R community. We meetup to improve R skills in Data Visualisation, Interactive Communication, Teaching, Reproducible Research and Data Analysis. contact us on: **gaborone@rladies.org** or visit **https://r-ladiesgaborone2021.quarto.pub**

Learn more about us through:
